acceptance.description: Managed product adopts exact reviewed utility only and retains bounded redacted terminal summaries

argv:
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path('.solopreneur/harness.py');expected='714d3758eb2d7dc309374c0b0ddba7556ac858d449d35582eda4c8f3c0367044'
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
managed=json.loads(pathlib.Path('.solopreneur/managed.json').read_text());before=json.loads(pathlib.Path('docs/runs/harness-output-adoption/before/.solopreneur/managed.json').read_text());before['files']['.solopreneur/harness.py']=expected
assert managed==before
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('applied_output',p);h=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(h)
raw=b'HEAD\n'+b'x'*20000+b'abc'*1350+b'\nFINAL: 73 passed\n'
script='import os; os.write(1,'+repr(raw)+'); os.write(2,'+repr(raw)+')'
r=h.execute_check([sys.executable,'-c',script],pathlib.Path.cwd(),5,secrets=('abc',))
assert r[0]==0 and not r[3] and not r[4]
for text in r[1:3]:
 assert text.startswith('HEAD\n') and text.endswith('\nFINAL: 73 passed\n') and 'abc' not in text and '[truncated]' in text
assert h.execute_check([sys.executable,'-c',"print('short')"],pathlib.Path.cwd(),5)==(0,'short\n','',False,False)
print('managed reviewed hash, metadata, bounded summary, redaction and short output PASS')
adoption.scope: Exact reviewed hash +managed metadata only +actual synthetic output regression; no product Native behavior changes
